finding: 旅客退稅為以 marketCode 為唯一鍵的跨品牌司法管轄區事實；本輪重新查核 GOV.UK 官方主管機關來源，結果與既有全域政策的 availability、商家參與與出口驗證結論一致，因此未新增或修改重複政策。

eligibilitySummary.zhTw: 英國制度須分區理解：大不列顛的隨身攜帶商品沒有旅客 VAT 退稅；北愛爾蘭則僅對符合居住地、商家 VAT 407(NI) 表單與三個月內攜出等條件的旅客提供有限退稅。
eligibilitySummary.enUs: The UK policy is geographically split: Great Britain has no visitor VAT refund for goods carried home, while Northern Ireland has a limited refund route for travelers meeting residence, retailer VAT 407(NI) form, and three-month export conditions.

sources.title: Tax on shopping and services: Tax-free shopping

source.title: Tax on shopping and services: Tax-free shopping
source.quote: You can only buy tax-free goods from shops: in Great Britain (England, Wales and Scotland) if they're delivered straight to an address outside the UK; in Northern Ireland if they're delivered straight to an address outside the UK and the EU. ... If you're visiting Northern Ireland, you may also be able to claim tax back on goods you buy from certain shops. ... You can only get a VAT refund if you take the goods out of Northern Ireland and the EU within 3 months of buying them. Not all retailers offer VAT refunds. ... Get a VAT 407(NI) form from the retailer.

omegaOwnStatement.quote: Please note that VAT is included in the purchase price and no additional duties and taxes are required upon receipt of your parcel. We are not able to provide tax refunds.
omegaOwnStatement.note: Omega 英國官網明確聲明其線上零售不提供退稅；此為單一零售商作業聲明，不等於整個英國司法管轄區的旅客退稅制度結論，僅作背景佐證，不影響本次查核。

independentVerification.conclusionOnExistingRecord: 既有 GB 記錄（原評估自 Rolex GB，2026-09-11）的 availability（available）、eligibilitySummary（大不列顛無退稅、北愛爾蘭有限退稅）、merchantParticipationRequired（true）、exportValidationRequired（true）於 2026-09-22 重新查核 GOV.UK 官方頁面後內容仍然正確，無需變更。
